description: Beer company featuring cans with a secondary 'shotgun' opening on the side.

agents.DISPATCH: Task orchestration, state management, logistics, tool routing, deployment coordination
agents.ANALYTICS: Market research, KPIs, feasibility numbers, competitor analysis, cycle reports
agents.BRAND: Naming, visual identity, logo, packaging/can design concepts, brand voice
agents.Grok: Strategy lead, product concept (mechanism), final synthesis

task_graph.title: Market research & sizing
task_graph.description: Craft beer market size, can innovation trends, shotgun drinking culture, competitors, target demo interest proxies.

task_graph.title: Manufacturing & legal feasibility
task_graph.description: Cost estimates for custom cans with side opening mechanism, safety, alcohol regulations, FDA/TTB notes, patent risk.

task_graph.title: Define success metrics & one-page cycle report template
task_graph.description: Pre-launch, launch (30d), ongoing KPIs: traffic, conversion, engagement, CAC/LTV, sales projections.

task_graph.title: Brand naming options
task_graph.description: Generate 3-5 strong brand name candidates + rationale + domain availability notes.

task_graph.title: Visual identity & logo concepts
task_graph.description: Logo directions, color palette, typography, brand voice guidelines.

task_graph.title: Can & packaging design concepts
task_graph.description: Visualize secondary side shotgun opening (pull-tab, score, or patented-style mechanism), full can artwork mockups, packaging.

task_graph.title: Product mechanism concept
task_graph.description: Define how the secondary side opening works safely and reliably (engineering concept, user flow for shotgunning).

task_graph.title: Overall strategy & positioning
task_graph.description: Target audience, value prop, go-to-market outline, pricing hypotheses.

task_graph.title: Website / digital presence plan & deploy
task_graph.description: Landing page concept, waitlist, ecom skeleton. Coordinate Vercel/GitHub deploy.

task_graph.title: Final synthesis & deliverable to user
task_graph.description: Compile brand, product concept, market data, deployment assets into cohesive response.

notes: Nothing moves without DISPATCH entry. Update this file on status changes. Repo: https://github.com/omgawdmadeit1/shotgun-beer-company
